vcon.description: Syntactic version of the JSON format used in the vCon

uuid.description: Globally unique identifier for the vCon

created_at.description: Creation time of this vCon (RFC3339); MUST NOT change after creation

updated_at.description: Last modified time of this vCon (RFC3339)

subject.description: Subject or topic of the conversation

redacted.description: Reference to the unredacted or prior less-redacted vCon instance version; mutually exclusive with appended and group

appended.description: Reference to the prior vCon instance version to which data has been appended; mutually exclusive with redacted and group

group.description: Array of Group Objects aggregating multiple vCons into a single conversation; mutually exclusive with redacted and appended

parties.description: Array of Party Objects for all parties involved in the conversation

dialog.description: Array of Dialog Objects containing the captured conversation

analysis.description: Array of Analysis Objects containing analysis performed on the conversation

attachments.description: Array of Attachment Objects for ancillary documents related to the conversation

ContentHash.description: Single hash token or array of hash tokens for externally referenced content

RedactedObject.description: Reference to the unredacted or prior less-redacted vCon instance version

uuid.description: UUID of the unredacted/prior vCon instance version; absence indicates that version is unavailable

type.description: Type of redaction performed relative to the prior vCon instance version

body.description: Inline content of the unredacted vCon; MUST be in encrypted form if included

url.description: HTTPS URL of the unredacted vCon; access MUST be restricted to authorized parties

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the externally referenced unredacted vCon content

AppendedObject.description: Reference to the prior vCon instance version to which additional data has been appended

uuid.description: UUID of the original/prior vCon instance version

body.description: Inline content of the prior vCon instance version

url.description: HTTPS URL of the prior vCon instance version

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the externally referenced prior vCon instance content

GroupObject.description: Includes or refers to a vCon to be aggregated into the whole of a single vCon conversation

uuid.description: UUID of the referenced vCon to be aggregated

body.description: The JSON unsigned, JWS signed, or JWE encrypted form of the referenced vCon

encoding.description: Encoding of the vCon body; MUST be 'json'

url.description: HTTPS URL of the externally referenced vCon

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the externally referenced vCon content

CivicaddressObject.description: Civic address information for a party's location as defined in RFC4119 (GEOPRIV); all parameters in lower case

PartyObject.description: Identity, contact information, and metadata for a party to the conversation

tel.description: TEL URL for the party; 'tel:' scheme prefix is optional

stir.description: PASSporT in JWS Compact Serialization form

mailto.description: mailto URL for the party; 'mailto:' scheme prefix is optional

validation.description: Token identifying the method used to validate the party's identity; SHOULD be provided when name is provided

gmlpos.description: GML pos format latitude and longitude of the party's location at conversation start (same format as gml:pos in RFC4119 PIDF)

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the participant; MUST be static across interactions for correlation

role.description: Role the participant played in the conversation (e.g. 'agent', 'customer', 'supervisor', 'sme', 'thirdparty')

contact_list.description: Label or foreign key reference to the contact list this party was on

PartyHistoryObject.description: Record of a join, drop, hold, or mute event for a party during a dialog

party.description: Index into the parties array for the party this event applies to

time.description: Date and time of the event (RFC3339)

DialogObject.description: A segment of captured conversation (text, audio, video, transfer record, or incomplete attempt)

start.description: Date and time for the beginning of this dialog segment (RFC3339)

duration.description: Duration in seconds of the dialog segment

parties.description: Index or indices of parties contributing to this dialog; for multi-channel recordings, an array whose elements are the party index or indices per channel

originator.description: Index into the parties array for the party that originated this dialog; provided only when the first party listed is NOT the originator

mediatype.description: MIME media type of the dialog content (e.g. 'audio/x-wav', 'text/plain', 'video/x-mp4')

filename.description: Original filename of the dialog file

encoding.description: Encoding applied to the body parameter

url.description: HTTPS URL where the externally referenced dialog file is stored

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the externally referenced dialog content

disposition.description: Reason the call or conversation setup failed; REQUIRED for 'incomplete' type, SHOULD NOT be present for other types

party_history.description: History of party join/drop/hold/mute events during this dialog

transferee.description: Index into the parties array for the Transferee role; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

transferor.description: Index into the parties array for the Transferor role; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

transfer-target.description: Index into the parties array for the Transfer Target role; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

original.description: Index into the dialog array for the original dialog between Transferee and Transferor; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

consultation.description: Index into the dialog array for the consultative dialog between Transferor and Transfer Target; optional for 'transfer' type

target-dialog.description: Index into the dialog array for the target dialog between Transferee and Transfer Target; SHOULD be present for 'transfer' type

campaign.description: Label or foreign key reference to the campaign this dialog is part of

interaction_id.description: Label or foreign key reference to the interaction ID

skill.description: Skill required to service this dialog in a contact center

application.description: Application, communication channel, or context over which the conversation was held

message_id.description: Unique message identifier assigned by the messaging system

AnalysisObject.description: Analysis performed on the conversational data

dialog.description: Index or array of indices into the dialog array that this analysis was derived from

mediatype.description: MIME media type of the analysis file

filename.description: Original filename of the analysis data file

vendor.description: Vendor or product name of the software that generated the analysis

product.description: Product name to differentiate from other products by the same vendor

schema.description: Token or label for the data format or schema of the analysis data

encoding.description: Encoding applied to the body parameter

url.description: HTTPS URL where the externally referenced analysis file is stored

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the externally referenced analysis content

AttachmentObject.description: Ancillary document discussed, presented, referenced, or related to the conversation

start.description: Date and time the attachment was sent or exchanged (RFC3339)

party.description: Index into the parties array for the party that contributed the attachment

mediatype.description: MIME media type of the attachment file

filename.description: Original filename of the attachment file

encoding.description: Encoding applied to the body parameter

url.description: HTTPS URL where the externally referenced attachment file is stored

content_hash.description: Hash(es) of the externally referenced attachment content

dialog.description: Index into the dialog array identifying the dialog this attachment is part of
